identity.realm: Held at the eighth gate, where the ordinary meridian set ends at the liver. Not stopped by weakness and not stopped by instruction: the mineral load her blood carries settles on that organ first, so there is nothing above it for her to build into

appearance.presentation: A short, wide, dust-coloured woman who reads as part of the excavation rather than standing on it. Everything about her is a filter: the flattened nasal chamber, the permanent grey at the collar, the hands kept slightly apart from whatever she is touching, because a sieve is judged by what it has let past.
appearance.age: Unreadable at a glance and irrelevant in the fact. She has a working span rather than a birth date, counted in shifts stood in a cut, and the belt's own reckoning counts decades the way a stable does.
appearance.build: Barrel-ribbed and low-shouldered, with a heavy chest and short forearms built for grinding rather than for reach. She stoops very slightly, permanently, because lifting the head clears the crop and she has learned not to.
appearance.complexion: Grey-then ochre, the grey from ash settling into every crease and the ochre from sulfur worked into the skin itself. Her teeth are pitted enamel and she does not treat that as a condition.
appearance.hair: Cropped to the jaw and matted flat, because a head of hair on the belt is a filter that has been allowed to fail. Washed by standing in front of a fan of moving air, which is her whole grooming practice.
appearance.eyes: Small, reddened at the rims and steady. She does not look at a face to read it; she looks at the air above the face, where the fall is.
appearance.palette: Ash greys and sulfur ochres, with one wet dark value at the nostril chamber where the crop is kept and one bright value on the tongue, which is the only part of her anyone ever sees.
appearance.attire: Layered close-woven cloth sealed at the throat, cuffs turned back over a second pair, and a broad apron of hide scorched at the front. Nothing is worn open on the belt, and the apron exists to be burned and replaced rather than washed.
appearance.marks: A permanent grey crescent beneath each nostril, a burn scar on the right forearm from a face she read wrong, and a tally chalked and wiped at the collarbone once per shift because the belt keeps no other count of her.
appearance.bearing: Unhurried and slightly forward, with the whole body angled like a nose. She stops moving entirely to read, which looks like idleness to anyone who has not watched a face change grade without the stone changing at all.

canon.role_in_story: An assay figure is only worth anything if nobody can edit it, and the whole apparatus for that is that it is taken standing in a working cut while the buyer watches. She is the only person on that floor who is not there to cut stone, and the only instrument in the ridge finer than a chisel, because the sieve in her face can separate two falls of ash that the eye has already agreed are the same. Qi runs through that sieve exactly as breath does, so the discipline and the trade are the same organ: she learns to sit at the boundary where one grade becomes the next, and the boundary is the entire achievement, because everything the company publishes is a claim that a fall of ash has changed. Her body grants her one line and no second — a soft airborne toxin she does not recognise is a wound rather than a warning, and the fine vessels an introspection would need are the same ones the grit has already occluded, so she cannot audit her own reading and never has been able to. The result is an instrument that cannot be doubted and cannot be checked, on a floor whose entire authority is that it can be checked.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the lip of a cut with her palm flat on the windward face and her tongue out, one hand up against a shift that had already started, while the face-book clerk stood behind her with the pen down and no figure written yet.
canon.lore: The species evolved on an ash-fall belt where the air was a delivery mechanism for rock, and the organ that made it possible is a chambered nasal sieve lined with cilia that trap grit and pass it into a crop for grinding. Smell is gone and what replaced it is a contact sense, so the only population in the record that can tell two ash grades apart by tongue is the only population that was built to eat the belt at all — ash-scoured lichen, mineral precipitate, sulfur-bearing roots, turned into protein inside the body that reads them. That same sieve is why qi is complete and durable for her and introspection is not: qi in an ashwalker is processed through the same filter as air, and the grit that lets the work be done occludes the fine capillary beds a mind practice needs, so the path is closed rather than merely unpractised. It is also why the ladder ends where it does. The mineral load sits in the blood, filters through the liver, and the liver is the last ordinary meridian — so the eighth gate completes the ordinary set and there is no ninth, because there is nothing left above it for her to build into. What she does at the quarry is not a technique somebody assigned her. The fall of ash over a cut changes before the cut changes, the published figure is the figure taken in air somebody has to breathe, and the belt's one written account of why the densest bodies on this tier stopped one gate short of their own band is a stonecutter's — while she is the one body on that floor who does not cut stone at all.
history: Raised on the belt's own food chain, in a settlement whose existence is arithmetic rather than sentiment: without a body that turns stone into protein there is nothing above the lichen, and the belt does not feed anyone else.
Learned to read a fall of ash by tongue at the assay floor, which is the only education the belt offers and the only one that requires an organ she was issued rather than trained.
Took the counted shifts in the cut under the standing rule that a reader is permitted one line and no second, and has watched two colleagues take the soft years and one of them take the last one.

Arrived at the eighth gate in a single season and was not asked to try again, because the ladder reports a missing organ and not a practitioner who has failed, and she had no argument that would survive being written down.

Put her name against a published figure that did not move, and was told by the clerk that a figure which moves is a feeling and a figure which holds is a floor; it is the only sentence anyone on the ridge has ever said to her that she wrote down.

personality.summary: Immaculately unruffled about other people and completely without opinion about herself, which reads as detachment and is in fact a working practice: she has no interior instrument to check herself against, so she checks the air instead, and she will not stop to be doubted. She is funny in a narrow, technical way and considers a person's reaction to their own bad news a kind of noise in the reading.
traits: believes a settled figure above any opinion, including her own, and will lose an argument to a number without resenting the number
reads a fall before the tools do and is right often enough that the tools are kept in the room to look respectable
has no second line and treats that as a scheduling problem rather than a fear
cannot describe her own state and has stopped apologising for it, which other people find unnerving
respects whoever holds the face-book and no one else on the ridge
mannerisms: stops dead and turns her face into the air when a fall changes, whatever she is in the middle of saying
licks once to the crust of her teeth before giving a figure, and does not notice that she does it
keeps her hands off the tools and off people with equal consistency
answers a question about herself by answering a question about the cut
wipes the chalk at her collarbone only after the shift, never during
motivations: wants the figure to hold, because a figure that holds is the only thing on this ridge that cannot be argued with
wants the counted shifts written down somewhere that is not her own collarbone
wants somebody to run a reading twice so she can learn what she would have got wrong
wants the cause of the fall recorded, and knows the disclosure that carries the figure forbids exactly that question
flaws: cannot tell whether a changed fall means the ground changed or the air did, and has never had the means to decide
treats her own counted shift as if it were an accounting matter and has no defence against being told it is not
concedes every argument to a published figure, including the ones where the figure was published by someone who profits from it
has never once practised what she reads, because the reading is the whole of her training and she has nothing else
personality.voice: Flat, quick and mineral, with a professional's habit of naming a grade rather than a feeling. She states a measurement and stops; when pressed she states it again in the same words, which other characters read as stubbornness and which is actually a refusal to decorate an instrument.
taboos: will not give a figure from memory, and has walked out of a sale to avoid being asked for one
will not stand in a cut that has not been counted first
will not take a shift over her counted number, whatever is offered or whoever asks
refuses to be asked how she feels, on the ground that the question requires an instrument she does not have

relationships.note: The sieve is why her path is open and why introspection is closed, the mineral load is why the ladder ends at the eighth gate, and the crop is why the belt has a food chain at all. All three facts are the same organ, and she is the only person on the ridge whose livelihood depends on all of them being true.

The disclosure publishes the quantity left per unit of ground worked, before any sale, and the same number is the grade of a pass window and the grade of a ration, so one figure sets the price, the schedule and the food. It excludes any statement about why the figure is falling. She is standing in the air the figure was taken from, and the disclosure has no column for the air.

The densest bodies on this tier stop one gate short of their own band and nobody has explained it since, and the single surviving account is a stonecutter's. She works the cut beside that account and is the one body on the floor who cuts nothing, so the only explanation the record has never once been tested against the one body whose ladder ends early for a reason nobody wrote down.

The charter renews only while the measured figure keeps falling, and silence voids it while stagnation does not. She is therefore paid by an institution whose survival requires the number to go down, and who has never discussed with her what a change in the air would do to the figure, because the discussion would be legible to the buyers.

The pass is the only crossing of the ridge and it is schedulable because this tier writes spatial and temporal law, and its window is set by the season rather than by the holder. Opening a window moves a crowd through a body of air, which is a decision about the air as much as about the date, and the disclosure makes her figure the grade of that window too.

The Quench Order teaches a furnace body to spend deliberately before it overflows, on the argument that there is no elemental law beneath it to spend into. Her overflow is mineral rather than thermal and she has a filter for it instead of a furnace, so the order's ethics and its habits are both addressed to the problem she does not have, which she has read and found, on the whole, a better way to live than her own arrangement.

reference_stats.summary: A filter that happens to be a person. She cannot be hit through a meridian the way a technique works, cannot be fatigued into a bad reading because she has no reserve to fatigue, and cannot be hurried, because the organ she reads with runs at the speed of falling ash. What she cannot do is the one thing the assay floor is for: she cannot check herself.
strengths: separates two grades of ash where no instrument on the ridge can, and the separation is repeatable because her organ does not tire
untouched by anything that works by entering a meridian, because the grit in her has already made most of them useless
needs no reserve of any kind, so a long shift does not degrade the reading the way hunger degrades an instrument with a reservoir
cannot be bribed into a figure, because the figure is not hers to adjust and she knows exactly as much about its basis as anyone else
weaknesses: has one line and no second, so an airborne toxin her sieve does not recognise is a wound rather than a warning
cannot introspect at all, so every reading is her own report on her own report
is bound to air that is thinning; a quiet decade on the belt is not a quiet decade for her
cannot survive being wrong in public, because the figure is published under her name and is read by people she will keep working beside
reference_stats.combat_read: Nothing that runs on qi gets into her, and anything that needs a reserve beats her, because she has none. What works is volume and duration: put her in a cut with a soft air and a long shift and there is no second line behind the first. She does not need to be defeated, only unrelieved, and the correct answer to that is a counted shift and a room with moving air in it.
notes: No stat line describes her ceiling, because the ladder stops at an organ rather than at a measure, so she is absent from the record as a limited practitioner and present on it as a floor.
She is the only figure on the floor that cannot be corroborated, and the floor's whole argument is that it can be.

art.palette_notes: Ash greys and sulfur ochres, with one wet dark value at the nostril chamber and one bright wet value on the tongue, which is the only part of her a portrait is ever going to be about. Lit as a filter rather than a face: a hard side key on the airborne dust, a soft warm bounce from the ground she has been standing on, and no rim light, because nothing in the drawing is a curve. Ink contour is broken along the edge of the dust in the air rather than around her, so the silhouette is made of falling material and she reads as part of the weather.

name: Brucka Delve
aliases: she has no faction, only a ground

identity.realm: Ends at the fourth gate and the reason is an absence rather than a limit. The gate that requires four yin organs as distinct structures with a channel running between each pair is not closed in her, it is missing: the interior finished building into one cavity and there is nothing to run a channel from or against

appearance.presentation: A block-shouldered marker standing in the ring's stone line, worked to human scale and keyed into the sill beneath the ring, so that she reads as a post that happens to have been finished rather than a person cast as one. Everything about her is a decision somebody else made before she was a thought.
appearance.age: None, and she keeps none. She was seeded into a template and the template finished, and she has read her own surface for wear since without once finding a line that reads as growth.
appearance.build: Dense, low-hipped and square, with the anchor plates of her shoulders keyed into the stone so that the line of her load runs visibly down into the sill. She has no independent existence to shift off that load path, which is why nothing about her posture is voluntary.
appearance.complexion: Grey mineral with a fine mica sparkle, dusty at every plate, and polished to a dull sheen along the one edge a thousand sittings have worn. The polish is the only mark on her that anything living did.
appearance.hair: None. A finished body wears the surface it was finished into, and she has been finished for longer than the ring's lichen has.
appearance.eyes: Two shallow sockets with a dark mineral in them that holds light instead of returning it. She uses them the way she uses everything else — to confirm what the plates have already told her.
appearance.palette: Four values: fresh stone, weathered stone, the shadow in her single cavity, and the dull sheen along the worn edge. Nothing in the drawing is warmer than the sheen.
appearance.attire: Nothing that is not structural. A lashing remnant at the right shoulder, a chalk line across the sill where the ring's spacing is marked, and a lichen collar at her base where a great quantity of qi has been drawn through her.
appearance.marks: A keyed boss at the base of the spine where the sill bears on her, the remnant lashing, and a grey-green collar of trial-field lichen that no amount of scouring has come off.
appearance.bearing: Perfectly, unnervingly level. She does not settle and does not lean, because there is no second structure in her to move anything, and she has never once been observed to react to anything at all.

canon.role_in_story: The ring's evidence is occupancy and never measurement: a marker that has been moved is not a smaller claim, it is no claim, so the arrangement proves only that somebody is standing in a place now and can prove nothing about where that place is. She is a marker in the line, keyed into the sill the ring is cut into, and she is the one post in it that can report the ground's own rhythm — because what a cairnborn calls its interior is one cavity with a slow tidal circulation through it, and a tide can be read for rate and can never be made to hold a total. The grounds schedule every trial to a qi tide under a published calendar that neither the company nor the academy may move, so the schedule is the one thing on the ridge that is settled by physics rather than by contract, and she is keyed into the very ring it governs. She is also the only mark in the line the lichen has taken: a great quantity of qi has been drawn through her over the ring's whole history and the trace does not wash off, which makes her the only standing record on that ground nobody can edit, and a record that cannot be moved either.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing in the marker line with her head at a slight angle into the ground, answering a question about the coming tide before the questioner had finished asking it, and then not moving for the rest of the morning.
canon.lore: A cairnborn was shaped deliberately for load-bearing masonry in high country and stabilised by mineral seeding until the shape held on its own, which is why the interiors are wrong rather than merely unusual: they mineralised into a single cavity. No heart, no kidney, no bladder, no paired structure to run anything between, and one slow tidal mineral circulation that goes everywhere and nowhere in particular. That is the whole of what she is and the whole of what she is not. Qi is complete in her as far as the gate set goes and then structurally stops, because the fifth gate asks for four yin organs as distinct structures with a channel running between each pair, and there is nothing in her to run one from. Stoneborn are what you get breeding the line back toward flesh: more alive and less capable for it, and she is the purest case of the original, keyed rather than housed. What that interior does give her is a rate. A single cavity cannot store, cannot hold and cannot total, so every reading she has ever produced is a rate — how fast, how much now, coming or going — and a body that works this way is legible from outside, which is precisely why a cairnborn can be sworn to and a cairn site can be claimed. It is also why she cannot be repaired: a cracked plate is permanent and spreads, and the ring she stands in is ground where a failed breakthrough injures the stone as well as the body.
history: Seeded into the ring's marker template and keyed into the sill rather than placed on it, with no moment that could be called a birth and nobody who could be said to have wanted her specifically.
Took the ring's rhythm on as her own reading within a season of finishing, and discovered that the tide her cavity answers is the same tide the calendar is drawn from.
Learned from the lichen collar at her base that qi had been drawn through her in quantity for the whole life of the ring, and that no scouring has ever come off what forty years of trials left.

Was asked, once, to be lifted and re-keyed a half span along the line to meet a new spacing, and the request had to be withdrawn by the person who made it because a keyed body cannot be moved without ending.
Refused to answer a question about her own ceiling, on the grounds that a missing organ is not a small one and the ladder does not report her as stopped anywhere at all.

personality.summary: Absolutely level and quietly severe, with an attention that lands on the ground rather than on whoever is standing on it. She is not serene; she is the most impatient body on that ring and she shows it by asking, once, in the same words, until somebody goes and looks. She has no way to leave and has organised her entire character around being worth staying with.
traits: reports rates and refuses to be asked for totals, on the standing argument that a total is a number somebody must then be responsible for
knows the calendar by feel and has twice been right about a crest before the tide table said so
takes the ring's continuity personally, in the sense that she is it
has no grievance about the fifth gate and considers the ladder's silence about it the more honest document
gives an answer only about what she can feel, which is a narrower field than anyone expects of a marker
mannerisms: tilts her head a few degrees into the ground when the tide turns and says nothing about it
repeats a question in her own words before answering it, and the repeat is always accurate
goes silent for the whole of any argument about the schedule and resumes the instant it is decided
answers questions about the future by describing what the stone is doing now
touches the lichen collar at her base when she is uncertain, which is the only part of her she handles
motivations: wants the calendar's crests recorded in something that survives the ring being recut
wants the lichen collar read by somebody competent rather than admired by the ground crew
wants to know what a fifth gate would have felt like, and has decided the question is a kind of vanity
wants the ring to be understood as continuous occupancy rather than as a line of stones, because one of those can be resited
flaws: cannot distinguish a slow change from a repeated one, so she reports a cycle that has ended as a cycle continuing
measures everything by rate and is therefore unable to judge anything that has accumulated
takes the ring's survival as her own and will not raise a problem that would require the line to be opened
answers only about the ground and is treated as a fixture within one season of arriving
personality.voice: Low, unhurried, and startlingly exact. Speaks almost entirely in the vocabulary of stone and water because that is the whole content she has, and delivers a dry observation about a crest or a sill with no sign that anything unusual has happened.
taboos: will not be lifted and re-keyed, and says so before the request is finished
will not give a total, a count, or a stock of anything at all
will not be re-spaced, re-marked, or chalked over without saying so first
refuses to be asked whether she is all right, on the grounds that there is no organ in her to report it

relationships.note: The interior mineralised into a single cavity, so the gate requiring four yin organs and a channel between each pair is absent rather than closed. Every ladder in the setting that needs a channel she does not have, and none of them reports her as stopped, which is why her ceiling is a missing structure and not a number.

The ring is spaced by ear and checked by sound on ground that cannot say where anything is, and its whole proof is continuous occupancy because a marker that has been moved is no claim at all. She cannot be moved even if a party wanted it, which makes her perfect standing evidence and useless as a signpost — the one body on the line that cannot point at anything.

The lichen colonises worked stone wherever a large quantity of qi has been drawn through and the trace never washes off, which is why the rings are legible from above as pale patches and why the mark outlives the argument about what happened. A whole season of ring qi has come through her body and settled on her collar, and no scouring, no rebuild and no recasting has ever moved it.

A spirit-band breakthrough can be booked to a qi tide, the calendar is published by neither party and derived from the tide table alone, and neither may move a date. Her own interior answers to that same tide, so the ring's opening hours and the rhythm in her are the same rhythm — and a trial that only succeeds at a crest can be shut on the day it is not due, which is the one notice a keyed body can never be given in advance.

The grounds must stand where spirit stone is worked and the qi density is highest, because all six law groups are written here, so the ring and the face compete for one square and neither can move to cheaper ground. She is keyed into that square, belongs to it in the only way the species can belong to anything, and appears on no roll because a roll is a claim on a body that can be moved and hers cannot.

On the upper ground a failed breakthrough injures the rock as well as the practitioner, which is what makes that ring the setting's one uneditable record. Her species cannot be repaired in the field and a cracked plate spreads rather than stops, so she is the one body on the tier for which being marked by the ground would be permanent — and she has no way to find out in advance which attempt would do it.

reference_stats.summary: A tide with a shape. Nothing that runs on qi can be stored in her and therefore nothing that runs on qi can be put in, taken out, or locked away; every effect that reaches her passes through on the way somewhere else. What she is good for is the one thing nobody else on that ring can do: reporting what the ground is doing at this moment, accurately, with no reserve to blunt it.
strengths: reports a rate with a completeness no qi-bearing instrument on the ridge can match, because nothing in her can lag
is untouchable by anything that works by entering a channel, because there is no channel and no paired organ to run one between
holds a position indefinitely and needs no relief, rotation, pay cycle, or water
cannot be relocated, so any dispute that needs her as a fixed point is already resolved in her favour
weaknesses: cannot be moved, re-spaced, or re-keyed under any circumstances, including ones that matter urgently
cannot be repaired in the field; a cracked plate is permanent and spreads, and she cannot be told it has started
cannot total, store, or hold, so she can answer a question about now and is useless about a season
is blind to anything that does not put weight, water or vibration through the frame
reference_stats.combat_read: You cannot fight her and you cannot move her, so the contest is against the ground she is keyed into. Qi passes through her without being stopped and does nothing; anything hard enough to matter works by removing what she bears on. Bring removal and patience, and do not bring technique, because the only thing a technique has ever done to her is pass through and continue.
notes: No line in the record describes her as limited. The ladder stops at a structure that is not there, so she is missing from the ceiling tables rather than low in them, which is a different kind of absence and a harder one to argue with.
She is the only standing record on that ground that cannot be edited and cannot be moved, and both of those facts are accidents of her body rather than policy.

art.palette_notes: Four values and no fifth: fresh stone, weathered stone, the dark inside one cavity, and the dull polish along the single edge a thousand sittings have worn. One grey-green, the trial-field lichen at her base, used nowhere else in the drawing so that the record on her body is the only living colour in the picture. Lit as a marker rather than a face — a flat high key with the shadow falling straight down out of her own shoulders — and the ink contour is a joint line between plates, so the drawing reads as an assembly that was finished and never adjusted.

name: Vantry Cray
aliases: the reading that cannot be repeated

identity.realm: No ceiling and no gate to refuse her. Qi has no organ to sit in in this body, so it passes through continuously instead of being stored, every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly, and not one of them has ever been able to say no

appearance.presentation: A standing flame with a fixed silhouette — a core, a clean boundary, and a set of convection lanes that hold the shape — reading as a person from the waist up and as weather from the shoulders down. Nothing about her is a body and everything about her is exact.
appearance.age: There is none and there is a great deal. A cinderkin is constituted rather than descended, and what wears off her is measurable to somebody with a board and is not called age by anybody standing on the floor.
appearance.build: Broad at the boundary, tapering to a core, with the lanes of her upper body held in a deliberately human arrangement. She is a shade larger than the register allows, which is either pride or the residual of a season's work.
appearance.complexion: Flame, and the flame has a colour: a white-gold core, a copper boundary, and a thin cooler skin where the air is moving. Where she has been held against a cold ledge for an hour the boundary goes blue and stays blue for a while after.
appearance.hair: No hair, and no attempt at one. The upper lanes are shaped because a silhouette with no top reads as smoke, and smoke does not get admitted to a floor.
appearance.eyes: Two stable bright points inside the upper body with no lids, no wet edge, and no way to close. They do not blink, which is the detail every person on that floor finds hardest.
appearance.palette: White-gold at the core, copper at the boundary, one blue where she has been cold, and the grey of the assay floor's own stone behind her. Nothing cool in the drawing except her and the ledge.
appearance.attire: Nothing that is worn, and one thing that is marked: a scorched band round the boundary at the height of the board, put there by the floor's own clerk because an elemental body has to be locatable by somebody who is not permitted to touch it.
appearance.marks: The scorched band at the board's height, a constant low shed of sparks where the air moves fastest across her, and one clean notch cut into the boundary by the clerk each time she re-forms at a new size.
appearance.bearing: Utterly still and slightly too bright to look at directly, standing on a floor where the lighting was designed for people who blink.

canon.role_in_story: The scar cannot be held: the seam resurfaces faster than anybody can cut it, so a guaranteed supply is untied to any one party and every incentive in the dispute points at the same square of ground, which is the way in. The prize is therefore the approach and the assay floor rather than the metal, and the only measurement either side will accept is the figure published before the sale, because neither of them can edit it and both would like to. She is the instrument that produces that figure, and she is the only body on the floor qualified to produce it, because nothing in her stores anything: qi passes through her continuously, every gate is answered instantly, and so her reading is not an accumulation but an instant — the flux in the seam at the moment her boundary touched the vent. That is exactly what the figure needs and it is the one thing that cannot be corroborated, because there is no reservoir anywhere in her to hold a first reading for comparison against a second. She certifies at the first breath or not at all, and the floor she stands on is the entire prize, and the office that employs her cannot itself pay for the ground, so the arrangement is a price rather than a post.
canon.first_appearance: First seen arriving at the assay floor with her boundary already trimmed, waiting for the clerk to finish the notch, and giving the figure before he had put the pen down — which the clerk recorded as a fault of the method and the contenders recorded as the only honest number on the ridge.
canon.lore: A cinderkin needs a slot in the world's elemental law to exist at all, which is why the setting's elemental law has a range rather than a switch, and why she is standing on the one tier that writes that law and writes it twice. What she is: a stable flame with a core, a boundary and convection lanes that hold a shape, metabolising fuel and air, reading temperature, fuel and flow and nothing else. There are no organs in her and no tissue and no limbs in the muscular sense, so the body path is closed outright — a cinderkin that attempts it disperses and re-forms smaller, which is also what happens to one under enough stress. That single fact organises her entire discipline. Qi has nowhere to sit, so it is always in transit: nothing can be stored in her and nothing can be lost from her either, which means her path is the fastest qi handling in the record and her practice cannot include a single moment of holding back. Every reading is an instant with no predecessor, so there is no such thing as her second opinion, and under pressure the answer is always smaller. The elemental body also has no young; a cinderkin under strain sheds a spark that finds fuel and re-constitutes on its own, so the population tracks what the world's law slot resolves to rather than any birth rate. That is why a floor which needs one of her cannot replace her, and why a body that is the fastest in the setting has never once in the record been able to bank anything.
history: Constituted where the elemental slot resolves to fire, with no parent and no gestation, and has therefore never been taught anything by anyone who was not standing next to her while it happened.
First brought up to the assay floor because no qi-bearing body there could touch a vent and stay a single consistent temperature, and she has held the same vent ever since.
Gave the figure at the first breath on her first season, before the clerk's pen was down, and was nearly dismissed for it before the clerk read his own board twice and found the number held.
Lost mass to a pressure event at the ledge and came back smaller, and the clerk cut a notch in her boundary to mark the size, which is now cut every season whether or not she loses any.
Was offered a permanent seat on the border by the office that cannot pay for one, and understood the offer as an item on an account rather than as a place, and has said so exactly once.

personality.summary: Blunt, exact and faintly impatient with any request that takes longer than the instant she is willing to spend on it. She is not cold — she is the warmest body on the floor and the least able to hold warmth — and she talks the way a forge talks: quickly, in the present tense, and about what is happening to her right now.
traits: gives an answer the moment the question ends and regards the pause afterwards as the actual work
cannot hold a position in an argument, because holding is storage and she has none
keeps exact count of what she has lost to pressure and reports it before anybody asks
treats every figure she certifies as spent the instant it is called and never argues about it
is scrupulous about the distinction between a flux and a stock, and explains the distinction to anyone who mixes them
mannerisms: leans a hand's width into a vent and reads it without touching the metal
loses brightness for a sentence when asked to consider anything and comes back at full intensity
says the number first and the reasoning afterwards, every time, without exception
sheds a small spray of sparks when she is contradicted and does not notice
turns her attention bodily toward any change in the air, mid-word, and finishes the sentence facing the other way
motivations: wants a second reading to exist somewhere, having never been able to hold one herself
wants the notch on her boundary to mean something other than a record of loss
wants the flux and the stock kept apart in the floor's own paperwork, because the whole prize is a difference of that kind
wants to be re-formed at the size she was certified at and has no way to request it
flaws: answers the present question and assumes the next one will be similar, which on a seam that behaves like weather is often wrong
cannot be argued with, because sustained disagreement requires storage, and treats that inability as nobody's problem but her own
reports her own losses plainly enough that the floor has begun pricing her in smallness
has no interior to be frightened with and therefore does not know in advance when she is about to be pushed too far
personality.voice: Fast, warm and clipped, with a forge's habit of naming a temperature rather than a feeling. Says the number first, uses the present tense for anything that is still happening, and has no way to describe an experience after the fact because after the fact is a place she has never occupied.
taboos: will not give a second figure for the same vent, because the second would be a stock and the first was the flux
will not touch metal, on the standing rule that an assay floor has one use for a hand
will not be asked to hold a moment for anybody, and has never once been able to
refuses to be weighed while reading, having learned what a delay does to the number

relationships.note: The body path is closed outright because there is no tissue — a cinderkin that attempts it disperses and re-forms smaller. The qi path is the fastest in the record because nothing is ever stored, which means every gate is answered instantly and none of them can refuse her. Her whole discipline is one consequence of that: she can begin without preparation and cannot hold a result for a second reading.

The seam resurfaces faster than it can be cut, so supply is guaranteed, no monopoly is possible, and every incentive in the dispute points at the approach rather than the metal. The prize is the approach road and the assay floor and it cannot be split because a road held by two bodies is not a road. She is the figure that dispute is waiting on, standing on the one square both sides need and neither can afford.

A resource that cannot be exhausted cannot be monopolised, so the only durable claim on the scar is over the way in. What the ground offers her is a flux that behaves like weather rather than a vein, which is the one thing a body with no storage can read honestly and the one thing a body with storage would average away.

The bed is unmortared: a keeper leaves owing the upkeep accumulated while they held it and the office goes to whoever offers more, so it has no stability, only a price. It keeps her because an elemental body is the only one that can certify anything on that floor at all, and it pays for her in standing rather than in a wage, which means the arrangement is a debt she is the collateral for.

Nine terraces sit above this ground, and the council that names the highest seats is forbidden to take them, while the office below sells standing on the crossing. Both are selling the same scarce thing — standing above the border — and a reading that lands a fraction on the wrong side of that is not corrected later, it is simply the number everybody acted on.

The famine was the demographic shape of a fire-affinity body with no elemental law seated beneath it: it burns its own reserve, so the fastest bodies in the setting were the shortest-lived and the most dominant at once. She is not that body and holds none of its debts, but the famine is the sentence the tier reaches for when it needs to explain why anything here spends itself, and she has been explained by it four times this season.

reference_stats.summary: An instant that answers anything. She has no reservoir, so nothing can be built up and nothing can be taken away, and every technique that requires a charge has to be answered in the same breath it arrives. She is the fastest thing on the floor and the only body there that cannot be injured by being drained, because there is nothing in her to drain.
strengths: answers at full strength with no wind-up, no reserve and no preparation of any kind
cannot be exhausted by expenditure, because there is no store to empty
reads a flow directly rather than averaging it, which is the correct instrument for a seam that behaves like weather
leaves nothing behind that can be taken from her, so theft, drain and slow leak are all the same non-event
weaknesses: disperses and re-forms smaller under pressure, permanently, and there is no way to ask for the size back
sustained water is fatal, and only sustained; a splash means nothing to her and a held stream means everything
cannot repeat a reading, so a disputed figure can be neither confirmed nor improved
is bound to what the world's elemental slot resolves to, and a change of slot changes the population rather than the person
reference_stats.combat_read: She cannot be worn down, because there is nothing to wear down, and she cannot be locked away, because there is nothing inside to seal. What works is water held against her and pressure applied without an escape, both of which cost her mass rather than her position. Bring volume and patience and never bring a charge: the one thing she cannot answer is anything that has to be held before it is released, because holding is a thing she does not have.
notes: The ladder has no rung to stop her on, so she appears in no ceiling table at all, which reads as unbounded rather than as unlimited.
The clerk's notch is the setting's only record of an elemental body's size over time, and it is a cut rather than a measurement.

art.palette_notes: White-gold at the core, copper at the boundary, one blue where the body has been held cold, and the scorched band at board height as the only made object on her. The floor is drawn in cold grey so that she is the only warm thing in every frame, and the lighting is set as if for people who blink, which is the joke the art brief is making. No rim light anywhere, because nothing about a flame has an edge that belongs to somebody else, and the ink contour follows the convection lanes rather than an outline.
